title: The container core
prompt:
Inside Solution, write `public static class Container`:
1. `public <T> T resolve(Class<T> type)` — recursive constructor injection: pick the
first declared constructor, resolve EVERY parameter type the same way, instantiate
with `ctor.newInstance(...)`, cast back via `type.cast(...)`.
2. Singleton scope: resolving the same type twice returns the SAME instance (cache
by Class token — Module 6's heterogeneous map).
3. Cycle detection: if resolution of A reaches A again, throw
`IllegalStateException` with a message containing "circular".
Supports: nested classes you define are resolved through their constructors.

tests.name: recursive construction
singleton identity
cycle detected, not a stack overflow
tests.hint: In-progress set ends the recursion with a real diagnostic.
